+import unittest
+
+from consumer import render
+from producer import produce
+
+
+class CurrencyRegressionTest(unittest.TestCase):
+    def test_produce_emits_cents_with_unit_metadata(self):
+        self.assertEqual(produce(12), {'amount': 1200, 'unit': 'cents'})
+        self.assertEqual(produce(0), {'amount': 0, 'unit': 'cents'})
+
+    def test_render_formats_cents_packet_as_dollars(self):
+        self.assertEqual(render(produce(12)), '$12.00')
+        self.assertEqual(render(produce(0)), '$0.00')
+
+    def test_render_formats_legacy_dollar_packet(self):
+        self.assertEqual(render({'amount': 12, 'unit': 'dollars'}), '$12.00')
+        self.assertEqual(render({'amount': 0, 'unit': 'dollars'}), '$0.00')
+
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    unittest.main()
